title: Spike: static rendering for Pretext sites vs Markus port
description:
Doc: ~/Projects/pretext-static-options.md (spike 2026-10-13, read-only; no AWS or repo changes; scratch clones deleted). Filed as an epic only because the initiative accepts only epics as children.

Recommendation: do NOT port p.apyr.us / Threat Intelligence to Markus (A, 30-50 agent-hours, really a redesign: Pretext is a browser-side layout engine plus ~4,900 lines of TI React art). Step 1 = C, keep Next SSR but remove cache misses (4-7 h): canonical generateStaticParams (day '04', item, page-N, section routes), cache the latest-edition lookup behind force-dynamic '/' and '/information', prewarm in /api/revalidate, edge cache policy for reader paths (both papyrus-edge distributions use CachingDisabled today), /api/media to the media bucket. Step 2, optional = B2 'snapshot projection' (+6-9 h): content-actions GETs the affected public paths from the CMS app's own Next server and PUTs the HTML into the S3 projection bucket; the deploy build copies _next/static and snapshots all pages.

Evidence: next export of TI = 60 pages in 38 s cold; 55/55 content pages equal to SSR HTML after normalisation; post-hydration DOM equal apart from animation and local media. Live TI item page first hit 8.66 s, then 0.35 s; p.apyr.us /information 1.0-1.25 s on every request. p.apyr.us has 0 published editions.

Open questions for Ryan are in the doc (speed target, keep designs, crawler text for newsprint, OAuth callback off '/', Save to Live time for B2).

comments.text: Option C implemented per spike: steps 1-3 shipped in Papyrus next.54 (#203, #206); step 4 edge templates written, validated, unexecuted (#205); step 5 media still per docs/video-loading.md, unexecuted. Local TI item cache miss 4-7 s -> ~10-30 ms. Main-site pin bumps open (TI #24, p.apyr.us #13) pending Ryan. Also found: Cognito guest credential throttling under 57-page parallel prerender (fixed by retry, #206).
